github.windows_x64_and_webgl: in_progress at last API read; parent owns these jobs.

assertions.name: Arena opens from its menu button with two live Slimes
assertions.expected: wave 1; two live Slimes; menu button route

assertions.name: The player uses the real melee overlap path against targets
assertions.expected: at least one queued and applied melee impact

assertions.name: Melee contact stays queued until a later 60 Hz simulation tick
assertions.expected: a collected hit remains pending during its collection tick

assertions.name: Accepted physical enemy impacts request the enemy_damage effect while audio output stays paused
assertions.expected: an applied Slime or Huesoguardia impact assigns the enemy_damage clip to an audio voice

assertions.name: Spawn contact stays silent and a real jump landing requests the landing effect
assertions.expected: the player leaves the floor, returns to grounded, and assigns the landing clip to an audio voice
assertions.actual: pendingAtSpawn=0; jumpStarted=True; airborne=True; routed=True; listenerPaused=True; clipAvailable=True; jumpCountBefore=0; jumpCountAfter=1; jumpTickBefore=0; jumpTickAfter=1

assertions.name: Both Slimes die through combat before the next wave
assertions.expected: two Slimes dead and wave 2 reached

assertions.name: The two Huesoguardias die through combat without forced removal
assertions.expected: two Huesoguardias enter Dead after melee impacts

assertions.name: Victory requires clearing both configured encounter waves
assertions.expected: Victory; zero living enemies; player alive

assertions.name: The standalone combat demo does not advance Expedition contracts
assertions.expected: CT01=0 and CT03=0 after a physical demo victory

assertions.name: Standalone demo victories leave Expedition contract progress unchanged after restart
